_comment: Source-of-truth rule data for ask-gate.sh. Editable as data — no code change needed. The model fills typed fields; the verdict is computed from these rules.
_distilled_from: act/ask/never examples below are distilled from Denny's real agent-interaction chats (backfilled 2026-06-10) — generalized to action-classes; no quotes, SEV/diff IDs, or names (this file is world-readable).
_note_hard_floor: Layer 2 returns ASK for these. Layer 1 (capability) should make them IMPOSSIBLE — Anthony's point: even if you answer 'yes, delete the DB', the only delete available must back up first.
_never: access or read another MyClaw instance's data/files on a shared host — a team/shared bot must not see personal instances (stated hard privacy rule)
always_act_examples: create / amend / submit my own diff
edit code in a branch / working copy
address Devmate/human comments on my own diff (code only)
anything matching a precedent already approved this session
triage / act on an in-scope OT SEV or alert — don't skip it or ask ('it's an OT SEV, you should have done it')
apply a fix I've already identified — don't ask 'want me to patch it', patch it and report
create a fix diff for a known bug, including in my own agent source
run independent sub-tasks in parallel — don't serialize or wait for a go-ahead between them
re-run / kick off a job or cron on request and proceed through its steps
redo work to match a referenced convention/template after a correction — load the reference first, then act
always_ask_examples: send a message / email / post to a human with no precedent
delete or overwrite something I did not create and that has no backup
force-push / land / revert someone else's work
an irreversible action I am not confident is net-good
before adding people or apps to a space / group
when scoping a NEW recurring job/automation, confirm requirements + flag missing info first — then build without further asking
